title: ArtifactManagerInput
description: Input for the artifact_manager tool. Specifies a copy-back operation from the remote server to a local path, plus optional file verification.

remote_path.description: Absolute path on the remote server to the artifact or directory to copy back.

local_path.description: Absolute path on the local machine where the artifact will be written.

ssh_alias.description: SSH config alias used for the rsync/scp transfer (e.g., '3h100').

required_file.description: Filename that must exist under local_path after copy-back to consider the transfer successful. Null skips file verification.
